subject.title: fix(secrets): surface degradation in logs and doctor

question: Should this PR intentionally extend cold-start SecretRef isolation from the existing TTS/model-provider boundary to web-tool providers and webhook routes, rather than remaining a diagnostics-only follow-up?
rationale: This changes the availability and fail-closed behavior seen by existing deployments, and the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human ownership of that compatibility/security boundary.

options.title: Endorse the broader owner isolation
options.body: Keep web-tool and webhook-route isolation, document the operational failure mode, and require current-head proof for cold, stale, recovery, and redaction paths.

options.title: Narrow to diagnostics
options.body: Retain only the observability and attribution improvements, leaving new owner classes to a separately approved behavior change.

recommendation.title: Endorse the broader owner isolation
recommendation.body: Keep web-tool and webhook-route isolation, document the operational failure mode, and require current-head proof for cold, stale, recovery, and redaction paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Introduced the merged SecretRef owner-isolation foundation that defines the behavior boundary this PR extends.
